prerequisites_for_real_database_executio.mariadb_service: Start MariaDB 10.4.32 daemon on host or dedicated test container
prerequisites_for_real_database_executio.network_binding: Allow local TCP socket connection (e.g. 127.0.0.1:3306) outside restricted sandbox
prerequisites_for_real_database_executio.snapshot_mount: Import verified physical snapshot SQL dump into isolated non-production schema (e.g. cbt_shadow_snapshot)
